faq.title: The short version
faq.a1: Yes. Streams, chat, country rooms and stamps are free for everyone. Only the New Year Pass and toasts are paid, and only if you want them.
faq.a2: The first midnight is on Kiritimati Island, {when} your time. Then midnight travels the world for 26 hours.
faq.q3: What do I need to watch?
faq.a3: Just a browser. Streams are open to everyone, and there’s nothing to install.
faq.q4: Where do the streams come from?
faq.a4: We gather open streams from cities, TV channels and webcams on YouTube and show them in the schedule, time zone by time zone.

faq.q5: Which country celebrates New Year first?
faq.a5: Kiribati: Kiritimati Island runs on UTC+14, so midnight arrives there first, at {when} your time.
faq.a6: The uninhabited Baker and Howland Islands (UTC−12) are last. Among inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC−11) celebrate last.
